title: Psalm 116: I Love the LORD, for He Has Heard
summary: A person rescued from the edge of death tells how the ropes of death entangled him, how he called on the name of the LORD, and how God delivered him. He then asks how he can repay such goodness, and answers by lifting the cup of salvation, offering a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and fulfilling his vows before God's people in Jerusalem.

from.where: The Study Bible's introduction to the Psalms
from.text: Songs of thanksgiving tell how God rescued someone, so that others can praise him too (Psalms 30, 34, 116).

line: A person rescued from the edge of death loves the LORD who heard him, tells his soul to return to rest, and lifts the cup of salvation before God's people.
guide: Answered prayer is not the end of prayer but a reason for more. When your heart still races after a hard time, say verse 7 to yourself. Is there a rescue you have never thanked God for aloud?

care.text: If your grief is heavy, please do not carry it alone. Tell someone you trust: a pastor, a friend, a counsellor. The Find Help page on this site lists places to turn.

stanzas.title: I love the LORD, for he heard me
The ropes of death and a cry for help
What shall I repay? The cup and the vows
Precious death, loosed bonds, and thanks in the temple

verses.t: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
